title: Casimir Effect for a Massive Scalar Field in Lorentz-Violating Aether Compactification
summary: This work investigates the influence of Lorentz symmetry breaking, introduced by an aether-like field $α_φ$, on the Casimir effect within a five-dimensional flat spacetime. By considering a quasiperiodic condition regulated by the parameter $β$ and an extra dimension compactified at scale $b$, we derive closed-form expressions for the Casimir energy and the resulting force between two parallel plates under Neumann boundary conditions.
